source: CUT! CUT! CUT! Team Review v3.0 sections 05-14
timing: English performance pass. Cues follow physical landmarks and practical sound. Silence clears the dialogue panel between lines.

cues.speaker: LARAS (MAYA)
cues.text: I used to sneak down here for a glass of water.

cues.speaker: LARAS
cues.text: Never had to turn the light on.

cues.speaker: LARAS
cues.text: I'd put my hand out just here.

cues.speaker: LARAS
cues.text: There was a door here.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Surya? My knee catches the sofa on that turn.

cues.speaker: SURYA (internal)
cues.text: Cut. I'll pull the sofa out of her path.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: From my mark, all I can see is the wardrobe.

cues.speaker: SURYA (internal)
cues.text: I need the patch in frame. Move the wardrobe.

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: Cut. Keep that one.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: I nearly said the line before I got there.

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: I liked the wait. We found the door with you.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Good. I'll remember that.

cues.speaker: CREW A
cues.text: Wardrobe stays here, yeah?

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: Leave it. We're in the kitchen next.

cues.speaker: CREW B
cues.text: Lamp coming through. Give me the doorway.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: When I watch a close-up, I fill in the rest of the room.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Tables. People listening. Someone holding a mic.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Nobody has to show me.

cues.speaker: CREW B
cues.text: Watch the lamp on that corner.

cues.speaker: CREW C
cues.text: You're clear.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: On this page she checks the plan twice. Why twice?

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: First she thinks she's holding it the wrong way up.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Oh. It's the room that's wrong. I can play that.

cues.speaker: LARAS
cues.text: Dining room. Kitchen.

cues.speaker: LARAS
cues.text: The stairs line up.

cues.speaker: LARAS
cues.text: There's a whole room past this wall.

cues.speaker: LARAS
cues.text: Hello?

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: I can't get past the cabinet with the plan open.

cues.speaker: SURYA (internal)
cues.text: I need to clear the way to the wall.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: I can see the plaster. Where's the outline?

cues.speaker: SURYA (internal)
cues.text: Turn the lamp across the wall. Catch that edge.

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: Cut. Print it.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Was that knock my cue?

cues.speaker: CREW B
cues.text: Heard it over here too.

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: I thought someone was at the door.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: So did I. That's why I said hello.

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: Keep that sound on the take.

cues.speaker: CREW C
cues.text: Last set's through the service passage.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Would've walked straight past it.

cues.speaker: CREW C
cues.text: I did. Twice. Come on through.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Cut from a face to a door and you think someone's coming in.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: You could have filmed that door last week.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: You'd still wait for it to open.

cues.speaker: CREW C
cues.text: Continuity photo's on the little table.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Do you want me to pick it up?

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: Leave it there. Look from the photo to the chair.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: And when I see they match?

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: Take your time. I'll stay on you.

cues.speaker: LARAS
cues.text: Who took this?

cues.speaker: LARAS
cues.text: That chair. The lamp beside it.

cues.speaker: LARAS
cues.text: They put everything back.

cues.speaker: LARAS
cues.text: Who were they waiting for?

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: The chair's in a different place in the picture.

cues.speaker: SURYA (internal)
cues.text: Match the chair to the photo before we roll again.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: I'm losing the edge of the chair in the dark.

cues.speaker: SURYA (internal)
cues.text: I'll match the lamp to the one in the picture.

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: Cut. That's the scene.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Can I put my pages down now?

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: Please. Keep the chair. One last pickup.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: I'll wait here.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Sometimes I watch an ending twice.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Same shot. Second time, I know where to look.

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: All crew to the back room. One last pickup.

cues.speaker: CREW A (radio)
cues.text: On our way. I've got the case.

cues.speaker: CREW B
cues.text: Lamp's set. Want it where it was?

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: Leave it. Thanks.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Surya? When I finish, could you leave it running?

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: How long do you need?

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Just a breath or two. I keep looking up on 'cut'.

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: All right. In your own time.

cues.speaker: CREW C
cues.text: Rolling.

cues.speaker: SURYA
cues.text: Action.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Okay. I'm ready.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: I left one name off when I introduced myself.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Evelyn. The woman who died in this house.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: She was my sister.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Afterwards, all anyone would say was 'an accident'.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Then I found the old call sheet. Four names besides hers.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Same director. Same crew. All here today.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: They had footage of what happened. Nobody ever got to see it.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: I wanted just one of them to say her name.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: We moved the chair. Matched the light. Did the whole thing again.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: The only person who said it was me.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: It wasn't enough.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: There's one more thing.

cues.speaker: MAYA
cues.text: Remember the rest of the room?

cues.speaker: MAYA (off camera)
cues.text: Now you've seen everything.

notes:
Scene 01 — The Arrival
Laras returns to her childhood home after years away. She enters the living room and notices something unfamiliar.

Direction: Give Maya a clear route through the room. Keep the unusual wall detail readable.

Scene 02 — The Hollow Wall
Laras notices an inconsistency between the house's floor plan and its actual structure.

Direction: Keep the corridor clear. Use the practical light to bring out the wall's texture.

Scene 03 — The Last Scene
Laras finds the room she has been searching for. The photograph reveals the room's former arrangement.

Direction: Match the reference. Let the photograph lead her to the final realization.
